astra.first: Trace the sun wheel to call your first astra
astra.ready: The astra is ready. Trace its sign.
astra.agneya: The Agneya astra: trace the sun wheel
astra.manava: The Manava astra: trace the wind swirl
astra.aindra: The Aindra astra, in Rama's name: trace the lotus
astra.brahma: The Brahma astra: trace the triangle
btn.title: Title screen
ch8.coil: a servant a servant your son a servant the throne lost lost the boons the boons ask tonight
ch9.stir: Someone stirs on the bank. Stop, and wait.
exile.drive: Hold to drive on, slowly. Let go when someone stirs.
ch10.pray: Mid-river, Sita prays to Ganga for their safe return.
ch18.obj1: Fly close to strike the chariot
ch18.bow: Ravana's bow breaks in his hands.
ch18.phase2: Ravana stands in the air and draws his sword.
ch19.obj: Drop the ornaments where someone will find them
ch19.trail: An ornament falls toward the trees.
ch19.landed: The bundle falls among the five on the hill.
ch19.again: Missed. The chariot turns in the wind; the hill comes round again.
ch21.obj: Taste each fruit. Keep the sweet ones for Rama.
ch21.sourNo: Not that one. It is sour.
ch23.obj: Hold to draw. Release when the knots line up.
ch23.hint2: Wait for the knots on every trunk to line up, then release a full draw.
ch25.m4: The fourth month. The sky clears.
ch26.mainaka: A golden mountain rises from the sea and offers him rest.
ch26.mainakaThanks: Hanuman touches Mainaka in thanks, and flies on.
ch26.surasa: Surasa, mother of serpents: everyone must enter her mouth.
ch26.surasaBless: In and out, small as a thumb. Surasa laughs and blesses him.
ch26.simhika: Something below seizes his shadow and drags him down.
ch26.simhikaFree: He tears free. Simhika is gone in a burst of painted dots.
ch27.seen: A guard looks twice. Hanuman slips back into the shadows.
ch28.remember: She closes her eyes and remembers Rama.
ch30.obj: Run the rooftops and set Lanka alight
ch30.grove: Has the fire reached the grove? No. Sita is untouched.
ch30.more: More of the city must burn.
ch36.north: Fly north to the mountain of herbs
ch36.obj: Carry the mountain back before dawn
ch39.obj: Light every lamp before the Pushpaka lands
diff.ask: How would you like to play?
gallery.title: The making of
gallery.intro: Every character's design sheet, and what the motifs mean.
gallery.thanks: Thank you for painting the whole wall.
hint.clickToContinue: Click or press Space to continue
hint.shield: Shield-bearers: roll past and shoot from behind
hint.climber: Climbers come up the cliff. Get close: the kick knocks them off.
hint.shootUp: Flyers: drag up to aim high
hint.shootUp.mouse: Flyers: aim high with the mouse
hint.astraReady: The boon is full: tap the sun to call an astra
hint.astraTrace: Trace the sign with your finger
hint.astraTraceMouse: Trace the sign with the mouse (or press E)
hint.holdDraw.mouse: Hold the mouse button to draw; release to shoot
hint.drag: Drag each one to a waiting hand
hint.lift: Hold to lift the bow upright
hint.bend: Drag down to bend it and fix the string
hint.pullBow: Hold to pull. Let go when it is full.
hint.row: Up and down to steer; hold Act to row hard
hint.fly: Drag up and down to fly
hint.jatayu: Fly close to strike; keep away from the red
hint.shrink: Now tap to shrink, and dart in when her mouth opens
hint.hide: Hold Act behind a pot or pillar to hide
hint.roofs: Run and jump roof to roof
khara.chariot: The chariot breaks. Khara leaps down and fights on foot.
khara.rule: Only a fully drawn arrow can end this.
kumbha.rule: Only his eyes, and only as he breathes in.
lose.rite: The rite is complete. Indrajit cannot be stopped now.
ravana.rule: Only the head in colour can be hurt.
ravana.boon: The heads grow back. Fill the boon.
scroll.title: The Ravana Scroll
scroll.body: A new door, in kachni line: the longer story of Ravana, told from his side. It will open in a later version.
set.toggleDraw: Tap to draw, tap to release
set.resetAsk: Erase all progress and seals? Settings are kept.
tip.general: Watch for the painted signs: a star means a blow, a lotus means jump.
tip.watch: A painted star means a blow is coming: roll through it.
title.name: Ramayana
title.sub: The whole epic on one painted wall
title.disclaimer: This is a work of fiction. It is here to tell the old story with reverence, not to hurt anyone's sentiments.
vali.miss: That was Sugriva. The duel begins again.
viradha.rule: No weapon can kill him. Break his arms when he swings.
yajna.flung: The Manava astra flings Maricha far out to sea. He lives.
boss.vali.rule: Shoot only Vali, and only when he is clear.
